classification.difficultyReason: Select the cumulative frequency polygon without a prompt naming it, convert the median to cumulative frequency 20, and explain how to read back to a height.

content.prompt: The heights of 40 plants were measured and grouped into intervals of 5 cm width. Explain how we can use this information to approximate the median height of the plants.

answer.short: On the cumulative frequency polygon, read the height in centimetres where the curve reaches a cumulative frequency of 20 (50%).
answer.worked:
Add the frequencies of the 5 cm intervals in order. Plot each cumulative frequency at the upper boundary of its interval, starting at zero at the lower boundary of the first interval. Join the points with straight segments.

Half of the 40 plants is 20. Draw a horizontal line from cumulative frequency 20 to the polygon, then drop vertically to the height axis. Read the estimated median height in centimetres.
